source_review.notes: Checked all ten structured primary references: RFC 3339 timestamp syntax and unknown-offset semantics; RFC 9557 zone annotations; IANA TZDB theory and rule limitations; RFC 5905 NTP clocks and uncertainty terms; RFC 8633 leap-smear guidance; POSIX realtime/monotonic clock interfaces; PEP 495 local-time folds; Apache Arrow timestamp parameters; Apache Parquet UTC-adjusted versus local timestamp semantics; and current PostgreSQL date/time behavior. Every cited URL returned HTTP 200 on the retrieval date.

evidence: Reviewed temporal tuple T=(kind,value,scale,unit,precision,zone,offset,rules,uncertainty,source), instant and local domains I and L, local_Z mapping, inverse relation R_Z, resolver rho, epoch/unit equation, lateness variables, half-open windows and uncertainty intervals.
Checked domains, cardinality notation, set membership, modulo exactness condition, interval inclusivity and separation of event, ingestion and processing variables.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation distinguishes representation metadata from domain meaning and treats local-to-instant resolution as a relation before a policy selects a result.

evidence: Executed event-time-boundary-audit with Python 3.14.4 and reproduced ingestion order (a,b,c,d), event order (b,a,d,c), lateness (500,2000,100,201) ms, window members (a,d), boundary assignment to the next window, 456789 ns precision loss and false exact-millisecond conversion.
Recomputed 1700000000123456789 ns divided by 1000000 as 1700000000123 ms with remainder 456789 ns.
Checked the one-minute half-open window [120000,180000): 119000 is excluded, 120000 and 179999 are included, and 180000 is excluded.
Checked RFC 3339 offset arithmetic example direction: local time minus a negative offset advances to UTC.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The numbers are deterministic boundary fixtures and arithmetic examples, not measurements of clock accuracy, network lateness or engine performance.

evidence: Re-derived R_Z(l) as the preimage of local fields under zone rules and verified possible cardinalities zero, one and two at gap/ordinary/fold cases.
Verified idealized epoch mapping i=E+n*u and the fine-to-coarse exactness predicate n mod k=0 where u_c=k*u_f.
Re-derived lateness L_a=a-e, platform wait L_p=p-a and half-open membership s_j<=t<s_(j+1).
Checked that uncertainty intervals and rule-version parameters qualify rather than overstate temporal order.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The epoch equation is explicitly scoped by time scale, leap policy, range and calendar implementation.

evidence: Reviewed ordinary local times, forward gaps, backward folds, non-hour transitions, offset/zone mismatch, ambiguous abbreviations, invalid zones, TZDB aliases, historical corrections and changed future predictions.
Reviewed epoch zero, negative epochs, signed endpoints, scaling overflow, seconds/milliseconds ambiguity, excess fractional digits, truncation/rounding remainders, collisions and false accuracy.
Reviewed leap-second lexical input, POSIX exclusion, smear/nonsmear mixing, clock steps/slews, monotonic restart boundaries, skew and synchronization uncertainty.
Reviewed out-of-order events, negative lateness, exact window boundaries, civil-day duration changes, late revisions, sentinel timestamps and database session-zone behavior.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Civil, numeric, clock, streaming, storage and operational-version boundaries have explicit handling or test requirements.

evidence: Traced meaning, representation, civil resolution, exactness, clock, time-axis, boundary, evolution and provenance invariants through the sixteen-step mechanism.
Confirmed the executable fixture separates occurrence from arrival order and uses event time for half-open membership.
Checked worked examples for retained civil intent, explicit overlap/gap decisions, original precision, wall/monotonic separation, leap policy, zone provenance and legacy-unknown migration.
invariant_checking.notes: No representation convenience is allowed to substitute for the timestamp's declared domain event or evidence quality.

evidence: Reviewed two distinct instants i1<i2 with equal local projection l during a backward transition and verified both belong to R_Z(l), proving non-unique inversion.
Reviewed a forward-gap local value g with empty preimage R_Z(g), proving the conversion is not total.
Checked the conclusion's scope: additional offset/choice evidence can disambiguate a fold, while an explicit gap policy can reject or transform a missing local reading.
proof_review.notes: The proof supports explicit resolution policies and does not assume every transition is seasonal or one hour.

evidence: Confirmed the local-date-time inverse argument is explicitly labeled Proof sketch.
Audited claims using exact, prove, always, unambiguous, preserve, authoritative, synchronized and traceable for stated domains and limitations.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No clock digits, NTP state, timezone database or successful parser is presented as unconditional proof of exact civil truth or global order.

evidence: Confirmed event-time-boundary-audit is labeled synthetic and not a streaming-engine or clock-synchronization measurement.
Reviewed all worked examples as constructed scenarios rather than claims about observed incidents or prevalence.
Confirmed runtime/TZDB behavior requires executed old/new corpora and canary evidence before production conclusions.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No production accuracy, latency distribution, external review or universal library behavior is claimed.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed instants, civil values, offsets, zones, rules versions, gaps/folds, RFC interchange, precision/accuracy, leap behavior, wall/monotonic clocks, event-time roles, windows, durations/periods and storage mappings as one temporal contract model.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed source-clock inventories, strict parsing, transition fixtures, serializer/database/session mappings, lateness and watermark policies, runtime/TZDB upgrade comparisons, canary rollout, recomputation, rollback and privacy-conscious telemetry. Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified progression from temporal kinds and representation through civil resolution, clocks and event-time operations. Ten nonduplicate examples and five complete exercise answers cover folds, exact precision narrowing, late data, rules upgrades and mixed leap-smear sources.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic, IETF, IANA, POSIX, database, runtime, timezone-maintainer, distributed-systems, clock-synchronization, legal-time or production-interoperability review is claimed.
